title: Correction by arbitrator of unconfirmed award.
bodyText:
Upon motion of a party made no later than thirty days after an arbitrator gives notice under section 658J-15(a) of an award, the arbitrator may correct the award:

(1) If the award has an evident mathematical miscalculation or an evident mistake in the description of a person, thing, or property;

(2) If the award is imperfect in a matter of form not affecting the merits on the issues submitted; or

(3) To clarify the award.
bodyHtml:
[§658J-17]  Correction by arbitrator of unconfirmed award.  Upon motion of a party made no later than thirty days after an arbitrator gives notice under section 658J-15(a) of an award, the arbitrator may correct the award:

     (1)  If the award has an evident mathematical miscalculation or an evident mistake in the description of a person, thing, or property;

     (2)  If the award is imperfect in a matter of form not affecting the merits on the issues submitted; or

     (3)  To clarify the award. [L 2017, c 113, pt of §1]
